parameters.query:
={{ `
WITH upserted_client AS (
  INSERT INTO clients (
    telegram_user_id,
    first_name,
    username,
    current_stage,
    updated_at,
    last_message_at
  )
  VALUES (
    ${$node["Telegram Trigger"].json.message.from.id},
    '${($node["Telegram Trigger"].json.message.from.first_name || "").replace(/'/g, "''")}',
    '${($node["Telegram Trigger"].json.message.from.username || "").replace(/'/g, "''")}',
    'new_lead',
    NOW(),
    NOW()
  )
  ON CONFLICT (telegram_user_id)
  DO UPDATE SET
    first_name = EXCLUDED.first_name,
    username = EXCLUDED.username,
    updated_at = NOW(),
    last_message_at = NOW()
  RETURNING *
), ensured_state AS (
  INSERT INTO conversation_state (
    telegram_user_id,
    sub_stage,
    pattern_type,
    current_q_number,
    qualification_signals,
    pain_points,
    created_at,
    updated_at
  )
  SELECT
    telegram_user_id,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(current_stage, ''), 'q_surface'),
    NULL,
    0,
    '{}'::jsonb,
    '[]'::jsonb,
    NOW(),
    NOW()
  FROM upserted_client
  ON CONFLICT (telegram_user_id)
  DO UPDATE SET updated_at = NOW()
  RETURNING *
)
SELECT
  uc.*,
  es.sub_stage,
  es.pattern_type,
  es.current_q_number,
  es.qualification_signals,
  es.pain_points
FROM upserted_client uc
JOIN ensured_state es ON es.telegram_user_id = uc.telegram_user_id;
` }}

={{ `
INSERT INTO conversation_state (
  telegram_user_id,
  sub_stage,
  pattern_type,
  current_q_number,
  qualification_signals,
  pain_points,
  updated_at
)
VALUES (
  ${$node["Telegram Trigger"].json.message.from.id},
  'why_1_opportunities',
  '${($node["Code - Filter Keyword Match"].json.pattern_type || $node["Code - Filter Keyword Match"].json.keyword || "unknown").replace(/'/g, "''")}',
  1,
  jsonb_build_object('entry_keyword', '${($node["Code - Filter Keyword Match"].json.keyword || "").replace(/'/g, "''")}'),
  '[]'::jsonb,
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (telegram_user_id)
DO UPDATE SET
  sub_stage = 'why_1_opportunities',
  pattern_type = EXCLUDED.pattern_type,
  current_q_number = 1,
  qualification_signals = COALESCE(conversation_state.qualification_signals, '{}'::jsonb) || EXCLUDED.qualification_signals,
  updated_at = NOW()
RETURNING *;
` }}
